title: MoralCLIP: Contrastive Alignment of Vision-and-Language Representations with Moral Foundations Theory
reasoning: The paper introduces MoralCLIP, which uses Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) as an ethical framework to ground vision-and-language representations. It evaluates model performance on moral categories such as care, fairness, and sanctity, the latter of which explicitly includes religious and spiritual themes and imagery.
